title: A test run on a remote host is executed and reported by the remote session, which notifies Central; Central never waits on or indexes a remote run
outcome: Remote runs are owned end to end by the remote session: it executes the run and sends a durable notification to Central, which reliably wakes the owner; Central registers no wait and keeps no index for remote runs
acceptance: The remote session that executes a run sends Central a durable notification of its terminal result (run id, host, input, result, fingerprints); the notification reliably wakes the owning session, proven by a test and by one live remote run

termal_resume_after_test_runs and other Central-side waits are not offered for remote runs: a call for a remote run id is refused immediately with a message that names the remote-notification route, instead of a 404 'not indexed'
No Central-side index, polling or forced rescan of remote runs is added; documentation and agent guidance say that remote runs are awaited through their END notification
The change is reviewed and gated under the standing rule
